recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-core unless a future editorial pass wants to revise the surrounding extension availability wording for reasons unrelated to FHIR-11268.
issue_request: FHIR-11268 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for DSTU2 extensibility section 2.20.0.1. It asked to remove the extra word "the" from "The StructureDefinition the defines the extension SHOULD be available at the identified location so that resource processors can access the definition from the URL"; the Jira resolution was auto-approved.
initial_application: The Jira comments record SVN revision 10281. Git history contains commit 1c0ab7b88658ade2e9f602152d54111b354d03b9, "#11268 - fix typo", with git-svn-id build@10281; that commit changed the sentence to "The StructureDefinition that defines the extension SHOULD be available at the identified location so that resource processors can access the definition from the URL".
additional_context: The current build-scope extensibility page is source/extensibility.html, referenced by navigation and hierarchy source. Later edits have refactored the relevant bullet, and the current text says the canonical URL is a reference to a StructureDefinition that defines the extension and separately says the structure definitions for the extension SHOULD be available to consumers of an instance. No current source occurrence of the erroneous phrase was found, and no Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes the auto-approved typo decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was necessary because the current source no longer contains the extra "the" and already conveys the corrected extension-definition availability guidance.
